{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check revenue format
print(f"Unique revenue values (first 10): {df['revenue'].unique()[:10]}")

# Check for QA test orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA test orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check status values
print(f"Unique status values: {df['status'].unique()}")

# Check channel values
print(f"Unique channel values: {df['channel'].unique()}")"}
